name: Carcedo de Burgos (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes, red, white and green in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carcedo de Burgos (a castle on red, a tree on white and a boar).
history: The flag is square, 1:1, with a red stripe of 0.25 of the width next to the mast, a white stripe of 0.50 at the centre and a green stripe of 0.25 at the fly, with the municipal arms at its heart.

features.role: Carcedo de Burgos arms — castle, tree and boar
